name: hatch-fill-type
title: Hatch Fill Type
description: Glyphs filled with diagonal hatching instead of ink: a repeating-linear-gradient clipped to the text, with hatch angle, spacing and weight exposed as controls — engraved-plate shading as a fill system.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Pattern Dial: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
